model: Poisson regression (log link, sklearn PoissonRegressor alpha=1.0, deterministic solver), one per outcome
features_note: the 7 locked propensity features from Tier-1 #2 (results/propensity_matched_null.json); covariate table rebuilt deterministically from the same committed source files
training_set: 831 unique matched controls (data/propensity/matched_pharos_stats.json) - the reference class for genes covariate-equivalent to candidates
fit_quality: 5-fold CV Poisson deviance + pseudo-R2 (KFold shuffle, seed 20260929), reported per outcome; a model that cannot beat the intercept-mean baseline on CV is reported as uninformative, not tuned post-hoc
primary_endpoints: median corrected enrichment (observed - expected) across gated candidates for publication_count and generif_count
fraction of gated candidates with observed > expected, all 5 outcomes
secondary: same quantities for gwas_total, ppi_total, n_drugs; per-candidate corrected values in full
interpretation_rule: if median corrected enrichment > 0 and fraction O>E > 0.5 for a literature outcome, residual over-annotation survives covariate correction: pre-declared reading is annotation bias on axes NOT in the 7 features (the literature-covariate gap named in #2), reported as measured. If corrected enrichment ~ 0, the raw gap was confounded by the matched features. Either direction is reported as measured; neither is adjusted post-hoc.
known_gap: outcome counts are not available genome-wide (Pharos per-gene API gap named in #2); the expectation model is trained on the 831-gene matched reference class, which is the correct reference for candidates but limits extrapolation claims
